title: Grateful Dead Live at Spokane Coliseum on 1980-06-14
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi CR7a => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: (FOB) 2 x Nakamichi cm700 >> Sony TC-D5  >> MAC . Master Cassettes (MAC) Medium Stock Brands: MAC = 2 x Maxell UDXL-II Analog

ai_review.summary: Warm, crystal‑clear audience tape with superb band playing, though some listeners note over‑Dolby high‑frequency compression.
ai_review.review: The recording captures a warm, clear soundstage with enough live ambience to feel like you’re in the venue, and reviewers rave about the vocals and guitars being crystal‑clear and the band being fully on. A couple of critics complain that excessive Dolby processing squashes the highs, which dents the otherwise excellent audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both performance and sound, but notable complaints about Dolby compression lower the overall impression, resulting in a moderate average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, clear and present sound with pleasant ambience praised by several reviewers; however two reviews criticize heavy Dolby processing that squashes the high frequencies.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers focused on overall performance quality rather than specific set structure, noting strong vocals and guitars throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work described as crystal clear and the band "completely ON".
